text:
Marta: FYI — Velovate's renewal is in 18 days. Their PM pinged CSM saying usage down ~40% last week and they're 'seriously considering a downgrade' if perf doesn't stabilize. Opening thread to align on a save plan. :warning:
Alejandra: Heard similar from our AM. They called out one big spike in 95p latency and a couple of failed calls that timed out during demo week. Customer is on our mid-market tier, not high-touch by default — we should avoid surprise credits but keep them onboarded.
Ethan: Logs look like the latency jump lines up with the runtime rollout on 2024-11-07. Quick grep from proxy logs: `latency_p95: 720ms -> 2300ms` for model redwood-3b-qa. Failures show `504 downstream_timeout`.
Ethan: quick debug snippet I used to repro routing to older variant:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.dev/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Redwood-Model: redwood-3b-legacy' 
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Alejandra: Can we offer them a short-term escape hatch (technical + commercial) while we stabilize? Suggestion: pin them to legacy model or route to dedicated pool for 2 weeks, plus a targeted enablement session so they can re-run tests.
Sanjeev: Agree. Proposed save package (2-week 'escape hatch'):
- Technical: route Velovate -> legacy model (config change) or temp dedicate to a small reserved slot.
- Enablement: 30m joint session (AM + CSM + eng) to walk through perf tests + best-practice prompts.
- Commercial: one-time invoice credit equivalent to 20% of last month's overage if they still decide to downgrade after trial (keeps them engaged).
Action owners and deadlines:
- Sanjeev: prepare routing change playbook + rollback steps (ETA: today COB).
- Ethan: validate a reproduce plan + perf dashboard slice for Velovate (ETA: tomorrow morning).
- Alejandra: schedule enablement 30m slot in next 4 business days and own communication (ETA: EOD today).
- Marta: draft customer-facing save note + proposed terms (ETA: tomorrow EOD).
Marta: I'll ping the PM with the proposed package and ask for permission to run the routing change while we do the enablement. Want to be explicit about timings.
Alejandra: Customer ok with the package in principle, asked for the enablement calendar options first. Said they can do afternoons PST.
Ethan: I'll attach a short perf test script to run during the enablement so we can capture before/after metrics. Example quick test: `for i in {1..30}; do curl -s -H "Redwood-Model: redwood-3b-legacy" ...; done` — we'll capture p50/p95/p999.
Sanjeev: Routing playbook notes (draft):
1) Add policy rule in traffic-router for velovate.com -> tag=legacy
2) Verify kv-cache TTL settings for their session keys (avoid cold-starts)
3) Monitor 5m and 1h p95; rollback if error rate >1%
(We should also include a cost estimate for a 2-week dedicated slot; ops will need headcount confirmation.)
Marta: Quick ask — can OnboardingBot create a shared feedback survey after the session? We want specific questions: perceived latency, feature blockers, and whether they'd consider year renewal at current price.
OnboardingBot: Scheduled survey template created: https://rdw-internal/surveys/velovate-escape-hatch (I will ping after enablement). :white_check_mark:
Alejandra: One more thing — capture any feature asks during the session (especially around streaming and stop tokens). If it's a deeper product gap, we escalate to product with a triage ticket.
Marta: OK — next steps are clear. I'll message the PM now with proposed terms and CC the team. If they accept, Sanjeev please run the routing change during the enablement window so we can show immediate improvement.
Sanjeev: Will do. I'll also post the rollback command in the thread before executing. :thumbsup:
Ethan: Adding quick perf dashboard link for reference: https://dash.redwood/velovate/perf?range=14d — will populate the before/after slice.
Marta: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers, @marta here. We'll reconvene after the enablement and customer survey. :eyes:
